item.title: Days and Opening Times
item.description: Read sports center notices to find out which days you can visit and what time to go.

children.definition: Any day from Monday to Friday.
children.example: The pool has the same hours each weekday, from 7 in the morning to 8 in the evening.

children.definition: The part of the day when it is light outside.
children.example: The outdoor courts are for daytime use only, so leave before it gets dark.

children.definition: Twelve at night, when a new day starts.
children.example: The sports center car park shuts at midnight, so move your car before 12 at night.

children.definition: Twelve in the middle of the day.
children.example: The pool shuts at noon on Sundays, so go in the morning.

children.definition: Thirty minutes after the hour you say next.
children.example: The notice says you can go in from half past seven, so get there at 7:30.
children.translation_ru: на тридцать минут позже названного часа (half past seven — половина восьмого)
children.translation_uz: aytilgan soatdan oʻttiz daqiqa oʻtganda (half past seven — soat yetti yarim)

children.definition: A word you say after a number to give the hour when the minutes are zero.
children.example: The first time on the notice is 8:00, so you can go in at eight o'clock.
children.translation_ru: обозначает целый час (eight o’clock — восемь часов)
children.translation_uz: daqiqa nol boʻlganda ishlatiladi (eight o’clock — soat sakkiz)

children.example: The notice says the pool shuts early today, so we need to go before four.

children.definition: On the day after this day.
children.example: It’s Tuesday, and the sign says we can come back tomorrow, so let’s go on Wednesday.

children.definition: On the day before this day.
children.example: The sign went up yesterday, but the new hours start next week.

children.definition: The day after Sunday and before Tuesday.
children.example: The notice says the pool is shut on Monday, so let’s go on Tuesday instead.

children.definition: The day after Saturday and before Monday.
children.example: The pool shuts at six on Saturday and at four on Sunday, so it shuts two hours earlier on Sunday.

children.definition: You put this after a time from midnight until just before noon. You may also see it written a.m.
children.example: The notice says 7 AM, so you can use the pool at seven in the morning.
children.translation_ru: обозначение времени с полуночи до 11:59 утра (12 AM — полночь)
children.translation_uz: yarim tundan ertalabki 11:59 gacha ishlatiladigan belgi (12 AM — yarim tun)

children.definition: You put this after a time from noon until just before midnight. You may also see it written p.m.
children.example: The notice says the pool shuts at 8 PM, so you can go after work.
children.translation_ru: обозначение времени с полудня до 23:59 (12 PM — полдень)
children.translation_uz: peshindan tungi 23:59 gacha ishlatiladigan belgi (12 PM — peshin)

children.definition: On each day. In a weekly schedule, this means Monday through Sunday.
children.example: The sports center lets people in from nine every day, so you can go at nine on Saturday too.
